q.line: Let every vessel pitching hard to starboard
stanza: A monument to build beneath the arbors
Upon a plinth that towers towards the trees
Let every vessel pitching hard to starboard
Lay its head on summer's freckled knees

partner.line: A monument to build beneath the arbors

q.line: He has heard her off to starboard
stanza: He has called her from the harbor
He has kissed her with his freedom
He has heard her off to starboard
In the breaking and the breathing of the water weeds
While she was busy being free

partner.line: He has called her from the harbor
